#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unpack quarterly_report.docx (stdlib-only) and dump paragraph structure."""
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path

SRC = "quarterly_report.docx"
OUT = "quarterly_report_unpacked"

# Unpack exactly (no pretty-printing, preserving original XML bytes)
with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zf:
    zf.extractall(OUT)

W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
NS = {"w": W}

doc_path = Path(OUT) / "word" / "document.xml"
tree = ET.parse(doc_path)
root = tree.getroot()
body = root.find(f"{{{W}}}body")

for i, p in enumerate(body.findall(f"{{{W}}}p")):
    pstyle = p.find(f"{{{W}}}pPr/{{{W}}}pStyle")
    style = pstyle.get(f"{{{W}}}val") if pstyle is not None else None
    texts = [t.text or "" for t in p.iter(f"{{{W}}}t")]
    text = "".join(texts)
    runs = p.findall(f"{{{W}}}r")
    bold = any(
        r.find(f"{{{W}}}rPr/{{{W}}}b") is not None for r in runs
    )
    underline = any(
        r.find(f"{{{W}}}rPr/{{{W}}}u") is not None for r in runs
    )
    print(f"[{i}] style={style!r} runs={len(runs)} bold={bold} underline={underline}")
    print(f"    text: {text[:120]!r}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Underline all headline paragraphs in unpacked quarterly_report.docx.

Headlines are section-title paragraphs whose text is all-caps and contains
letters (empty/body/bullet paragraphs are excluded). For each such paragraph,
insert <w:u w:val="single"/> into every run's rPr via targeted text edits so
all other XML content is preserved byte-for-byte.
"""
import re
from pathlib import Path

DOC = Path("quarterly_report_unpacked/word/document.xml")
xml = DOC.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

PARA_RE = re.compile(r"<w:p\b[^>]*>.*?</w:p>", flags=re.S)
TEXT_RE = re.compile(r"<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>", flags=re.S)

underlined = []
new_xml = []
pos = 0
for m in PARA_RE.finditer(xml):
    para = m.group(0)
    text = "".join(TEXT_RE.findall(para))
    is_headline = bool(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", text)) and text.upper() == text
    if is_headline:
        count = para.count("</w:rPr>")
        para = para.replace("</w:rPr>", '<w:u w:val="single"/></w:rPr>')
        # safety: any run without rPr gets one (none expected here)
        if count == 0:
            para = re.sub(r"<w:r>", '<w:r><w:rPr><w:u w:val="single"/></w:rPr>', para)
        underlined.append((len(underlined) + 1, text, count))
    new_xml.append(xml[pos:m.start()])
    new_xml.append(para)
    pos = m.end()
new_xml.append(xml[pos:])

DOC.write_text("".join(new_xml), encoding="utf-8")

print(f"Underlined {len(underlined)} headline paragraph(s):")
for idx, text, runs in underlined:
    print(f"  {idx}. {text!r} ({runs} run(s) updated)")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pack edited unpacked dir back into quarterly_report.docx (stdlib-only).

Preserves the original archive's entry order and stores files with the same
compression, so the output differs only in the edited document.xml.
"""
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

SRC_DIR = Path("quarterly_report_unpacked")
OUT = "quarterly_report.docx"

# Original entry order (the original file is still on disk, untouched)
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT) as zf:
    names = zf.namelist()

with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
    for name in names:
        f = SRC_DIR / name
        if f.is_file():
            zf.write(f, name)
        elif name.endswith("/"):
            # directory entry
            zi = zipfile.ZipInfo(name)
            zf.writestr(zi, b"")

print(f"Packed {sum(1 for n in names if (SRC_DIR / n).is_file())} files into {OUT}")

# Quick validity check
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT) as zf:
    bad = zf.testzip()
    xml = zf.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")
    names2 = zf.namelist()
print(f"Zip integrity OK: {bad is None}")
print(f"First entry is [Content_Types].xml: {names2[0] == '[Content_Types].xml'}")
print(f"Underline tags in document.xml: {xml.count('<w:u w:val=\"single\"/>')}")
